# Dockio

> Dockio Technosolutions Private Limited is an enterprise AI implementation and systems-integration company based in Mumbai, India, and an OpenAI Select Partner. It helps enterprise teams prioritise AI use cases, implement governed workflows and connect meaningful adoption to evidence of business value.

Dockio's primary industry focus is banking and financial services, including enterprise and group AI platforms and banking GCCs. Other relevant engagements include private equity portfolio companies, enterprise operations and professional services. Its brand promise is “Make AI work. In your business.”

## Company and partnership

- [Dockio homepage](https://www.dockio.in/): Overview, engagement choices, illustrative workflow and frequently asked questions.
- [About Dockio](https://www.dockio.in/about/): Company focus, Mumbai location and leadership. Individual professional experience is distinct from contracts delivered by Dockio.
- [OpenAI Select partnership](https://www.dockio.in/openai/): Dockio's Select organisational tier and independent implementation services around ChatGPT adoption, API integration, agentic workflows and Codex enablement.
- [Delivery approach](https://www.dockio.in/approach/): Defined outcomes, approved sources and access, evaluation, human review, operating ownership and adoption evidence.

## Services

- [AI implementation engagements](https://www.dockio.in/services/): Overview of assessment, embedded implementation and adoption services.
- [AI opportunity and investment assessment](https://www.dockio.in/services/strategy/): Prioritised use cases, a value hypothesis, feasibility, dependencies and a scoped implementation proposal.
- [Embedded AI implementation](https://www.dockio.in/services/integration/): Defined workflows, integrations, controls, evaluation evidence and operating handover alongside enterprise teams.
- [Governed agentic workflows](https://www.dockio.in/services/workflows/): Multi-step work involving approved information, tools, people and explicit approval boundaries.
- [Adoption and value realisation](https://www.dockio.in/services/adoption/): Adoption friction, task quality, operational outcomes and financial validation.
- [AI Implementation and Value Sprint](https://www.dockio.in/services/implementation-sprint/): A scoped paid engagement for one workflow. Timing, dependencies, acceptance criteria and commercial terms are agreed before delivery.

## Industries

- [Industry focus](https://www.dockio.in/industries/): Banking, portfolios and enterprise work.
- [Banking and financial services](https://www.dockio.in/industries/financial-services/): Use-case prioritisation, governed implementation and adoption for enterprise AI platform owners, sponsors and banking GCCs.
- [Private equity and portfolio companies](https://www.dockio.in/industries/private-equity/): Repeatable AI opportunities tied to operating priorities, assessed and implemented in each company's context.
- [Enterprise operations](https://www.dockio.in/industries/enterprise-operations/): Document-heavy workflows and handoffs across business functions.
- [Professional services](https://www.dockio.in/industries/professional-services/): Research, synthesis and knowledge-intensive work with professional review.

## Illustrative workflow and product direction

- [Illustrative delivery example](https://www.dockio.in/delivery-example/): A synthetic investment-case review showing a business brief, evidence gaps, human review and next actions. It uses no client data or live AI execution.
- [BudgetOps](https://www.dockio.in/budgetops/): In-development, recommendation-first AI investment intelligence. It is intended to connect delivery, adoption and realised-value evidence to the next funding decision for product/project managers, Finance and business sponsors. Described capabilities are product direction, not a claim that all features are available today.

## Implementation perspectives

- [All perspectives](https://www.dockio.in/insights/): Practical guidance on enterprise AI delivery and business value.
- [Moving beyond an AI pilot](https://www.dockio.in/insights/beyond-the-pilot/): Integration dependencies, failure handling, operational ownership and readiness for everyday work.
- [Choosing the business task first](https://www.dockio.in/insights/start-with-the-work/): Workflow requirements, visible assumptions and a defined first increment.
- [Connecting usage to business value](https://www.dockio.in/insights/beyond-usage/): Task completion, quality, rework and validated financial effects. Estimated time savings are distinct from realised financial value.

## Contact and interpretation

- [Discuss a requirement](https://www.dockio.in/contact/): Book a conversation or prepare an implementation, embedded-team, adoption, RFI/RFP or BudgetOps email enquiry.
- [Website privacy information](https://www.dockio.in/privacy/): Information handling for website visits, email enquiries and Microsoft Bookings.

Business contact: sankalp@dockio.in. Location: Mumbai, India.

Website enquiry forms prepare an email draft on the visitor's device. They do not automatically submit or store enquiries. The visitor reviews and sends the email. Meeting scheduling uses Microsoft Bookings.

Workflow examples are illustrative patterns, not customer case studies or achieved-result claims. No guaranteed delivery duration or ROI is stated. OpenAI Select identifies Dockio's organisational partner tier; descriptions of services do not imply separate specialization badges or an OpenAI guarantee of Dockio's work. Dockio supplies its own professional services. OpenAI product subscriptions and usage terms remain governed by the relevant OpenAI agreements.
